baseline.launch:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
source "/home/ubuntu/qwen-serve/.venv/bin/activate"
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.0 PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.0/bin:$PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-13.0/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}

sglang serve "/home/ubuntu/models/Qwen3.5-27B-AWQ-4bit" \
  --served-model-name qwen3.5-27b \
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 \
  --attention-backend flashinfer \
  --sampling-backend flashinfer \
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \
  --context-length 32768 \
  --mem-fraction-static 0.88 \
  --max-running-requests 32 \
  --chunked-prefill-size 4096 \
  --enable-metrics \
  --enable-cache-report \
  --log-level info --reasoning-parser qwen3 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 32 2>&1 | tee "/home/ubuntu/qwen-serve/logs/server_27b_awq_20261022_205720.log"
